name: Dr. Joshua Stroschien
biography: Dr. Josh Stroschien is a professor at Dakota State University. Dr. Josh Stroschein teaches undergraduate and graduate courses in cyber security with a focus on malware analysis, reverse engineering and software exploitation. His research interests include malware analysis and software exploitation. Outside of DSU, you can find Josh providing training at such venues as DerbyCon, Hack-In-The-Box and ToorCon. Website: https://0xevilc0de.com
